revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found — all quotes check out against the transcript. However, three cherry_pick_moments misapply schema categories in ways that would mislead a manager reading the coaching brief: (1) the 01:33 moment labeled 'setter_scope_creep' is really a knowledge-gap/clarity problem — the rep is answering a financing question the customer directly asked, just doing it incoherently; scope_discipline is about debating closer-tier technical content, which this borders on but doesn't cleanly match. Reclassify primarily as knowledge_gap with scope_creep as secondary framing. (2) the 01:50 'objection_inversion_miss' misapplies the objection_inversion schema, which is defined for cost/time/interest OBJECTIONS ('too expensive', 'not interested'), not clarifying pricing questions. Stage 3's own alternative_hypothesis text correctly points toward bill_anchor as the better frame — promote that to the primary classification and drop the objection_inversion label. (3) the 05:38 'cross_sell_miss' classification is a schema misuse: cross_sell_signals in Ion's schema is specifically roofing/battery/secondary-structure signals, not the cash-purchase payment alternative. Reclassify as a DQ-process/qualifier completeness issue under qualifiers.credit_qualifier or dq_rules, not cross_sell_signals. Additionally, tighten the trajectory_verdict language at 05:38 to acknowledge the rep DID raise cash-purchase once (at 02:26) rather than implying it was never considered at all — the real gap is failure to re-offer it at closing, which coaching_focus priority 2 already states correctly; align the trajectory_verdict summary with that more precise framing. These are targeted classification/schema-reference fixes, not quote or outcome problems — the underlying observations and coaching intent are sound and should be preserved, just re-anchored to the correct schema sections.
